Author: FunkyJumbo
Name: DPS In Server Bar
Punchline: Your live DPS, rDPS and party DPS, right in the server info bar.
Description: Shows your real-time DPS, party DPS or FFLogs-style rDPS in the server info bar, with your rank, role comparison, boss HP and projected kill time. Includes a live breakdown window, graphs, pull history with comparisons, party DPS checks and an optional FFLogs percentile estimate. Works with ACT (OverlayPlugin WebSocket) or on its own with the built-in tracker.
Changelog:
- History: filter pulls by kind of content (Dungeons, Trials, Extreme, Raids, Savage, Ultimate, Other), one or several at once. Works for pulls already recorded.
- Chat summary: choose the values shown (job, DPS, rDPS, FFLogs %, GCD, pDPS, deaths), separated by |. rDPS now has its rank. DPS, rDPS, GCD and pDPS can each show NEW BEST (+2.1%) or the gap to your best kill.
- The pace vs your best kill now reads Best +4% in the server bar.
- Live and History: the player tables fit the number of players (no scrollbar, no empty space in smaller groups).
- Fix: the default AAC Heavyweight M1/M2 (Savage) party checks pointed at the wrong zones (Abyssos); existing settings are corrected automatically.
